standard_prerequisites.use: Because $f_*$ is exact, $Rf_*$ is computed by applying $f_*$ to any representative complex, which turns the derived statement into a termwise one.

standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology on Sites, labels sites-cohomology-lemma-K-flat-resolution (invoked at proof line 626) and sites-cohomology-lemma-pullback-K-flat (invoked at proof line 628)
standard_prerequisites.use: They provide a K-flat complex with flat terms representing $K$, whose pullback is again K-flat with flat terms, so that the derived tensor products are computed by the naive total complexes.

standard_prerequisites.name: The pushforward along a finite morphism commutes with direct sums, and the non-derived projection formula
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, labels lemma-stalk-push-finite (invoked at proof line 641) and lemma-finite-rings (invoked at proof line 648)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first, through the stalk description, gives the commutation with direct sums used to pass to terms; the second is exactly the termwise equality $\mathcal{K}^n \otimes_\mathcal{B} f_*\mathcal{M}^m = f_*(f^*\mathcal{K}^n \otimes_\mathcal{A} \mathcal{M}^m)$.

core_obligations: Use exactness of $f_*$ on the relevant abelian categories to compute $Rf_*$ by applying $f_*$ to a representative complex (proof lines 622-623).

Choose a K-flat complex $\mathcal{K}^\bullet$ with flat terms representing $K$ and note that $f^*\mathcal{K}^\bullet$ is K-flat with flat terms, so that the two sides of the formula are represented by the total complexes displayed (proof lines 624-638).

Use that $f_*$ commutes with direct sums, via the stalk description of the pushforward along a finite morphism, to reduce the identification of the total complexes to the termwise equalities (proof lines 639-647).
Conclude those termwise equalities by the non-derived projection formula of the preceding lemma (proof lines 643-648).
proof_roadmap: Exactness of $f_*$ and the choice of representatives (proof lines 622-623).
K-flat resolutions and the total complexes (proof lines 624-638).
Reduction to terms via commutation with direct sums (proof lines 639-647).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the derived projection formula for a finite morphism of algebraic spaces equipped with sheaves of rings, comparing the derived tensor product with the pushforward of the derived tensor product (statement lines 609-619). The proof uses exactness of the pushforward to represent the functor by the naive pushforward, chooses K-flat resolutions so that the derived tensor products become total complexes, and then reduces to the termwise non-derived projection formula using that the pushforward commutes with direct sums. The reduction through K-flat resolutions is the substance, so the claim is H2.
